decisions.reason: As an organic line close to the core assortment, it fits the firm's stated growth path and is still an early, low-cost option to keep open, though its weaker website prominence suggests somewhat higher exit risk than the others.

This product closely matches both the firm's existing capabilities and its push into organic products and new snack formats, so with industry growth and only limited time to learn, management would likely continue it.

Because it is a near-core extension in a growing market and was given its own product page, the firm would likely retain it while uncertainty about repeat demand resolves, despite a slightly less direct fit with the organic expansion focus.
